job.title: Senior Data Engineer - Platform
job.description:
Tessellate AI builds forecasting software for grocery chains. We are hiring a senior data engineer to own the pipelines that feed our models.

You will: build streaming ingestion from point-of-sale feeds; run our Snowflake warehouse and dbt project; own production pipeline reliability end to end.

You have: 6+ years of data engineering; Python, SQL; Kafka or Kinesis; experience on call for production data systems. Databricks is a plus, not required.

US remote. Salary: $160,000 - $190,000.
